audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and level 6 read 'Skill' and 2+ items read 'Olaf'; the applied mirror sets rows 1 through first item to Olaf and two-plus items to Skill. The whys were also offset by one label (whys[3] described level 6, whys[4] and whys[5] both described the first item).
audit.why: Level 6 is the stage Ragnarok comes online and blanks Thundering Smash — it cannot be the stage Volibear is even. And a front-loaded Olaf at two items no longer out-scales a drain-tank.
audit.corrected: phases[3..4].side and win[3..4] to Olaf, phases[6].side and win[6] to Skill; ratings 4, 4, 4, 3, 4, 6 across rows 1-6; whys re-aligned to their own labels.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ item spike claimed 'you take over here' and 'a late Volibear out-bulks and out-DPSes a fallen-off Olaf every fight'.
audit.why: Reckless Swing is true damage — it ignores armour and MR entirely, so the resistances that make Volibear a drain-tank do nothing against his main damage source. The stage is even, not a takeover.
audit.corrected: spikes[3] and late restated: you survive him through sustain and the Frenzied Maul re-bite, not by stacking resistances against true damage.
sources: brief enemyKit E trueDamage flag + Riot text

audit.whatIsWrong: Three factual errors. (1) 'W Vicious Strikes gives him lifesteal' — Olaf's W is Tough It Out and it grants attack speed and a SHIELD, no lifesteal; the lifesteal is the passive Berserker Rage and it scales with his MISSING health. (2) Undertow was described as only a slow — it also reduces armour, and picking the axe up RESETS its 9s cooldown. (3) Ragnarok was called flat 'unstoppable' — Riot's text is immunity to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.
audit.why: The lifesteal error is the worst of the three: a player who thinks the sustain is on a 12-16s W will wait it out, when in fact it grows as Olaf drops low — exactly when he is winning the trade. The axe-reset is the reason he sticks to you, and it is denied by walking over the axe.
audit.corrected: Berserker Rage: attack speed and lifesteal from missing Health. Undertow: 1000 range, 9s, armour and move-speed reduction, cooldown resets on pickup. Tough It Out: 16/15/14/13/12s attack speed plus shield. Reckless Swing: 325 range, 11/10/9/8/7s, true damage, health cost refunded on a kill. Ragnarok: 100/90/80s, disable-immune while he keeps attacking.

edits.after: Stormbringer disables his tower, but Ragnarok ignores your stun while he keeps swinging — leap in only after that window ends.

edits.before: Olaf out-duels you early. His Q Undertow axe slows you hard and lets him kite in, W Vicious Strikes gives him lifesteal to win the extended trade, and E Reckless Swing is true damage that ignores your bulk. Don't stand and fight — dodge the axe pickup and disengage.
edits.after: Olaf out-duels you early. Undertow's axe shreds armour and slows, and picking it up resets the 9s cooldown; Tough It Out shields him and speeds his attacks; Reckless Swing is true damage your armour cannot touch. Don't stand and fight — walk over the axe first, then disengage.

edits.before: Ragnarok makes Olaf unstoppable, so your Q Thundering Smash stun does nothing during his ult. If he all-ins with R active you can't peel him — don't R in expecting to CC-lock him, wait out the unstoppable window.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes him immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking, so Thundering Smash's stun does nothing inside it. Never open the all-in there — wait the window out, and remember it is only 100s at rank 1.

edits.before: You take over here. Olaf is one of the hardest-falling champions in the game — once you have bruiser items and R uptime, his true damage no longer scales while your durability and DPS overwhelm him. A late-game Volibear simply out-sustains and out-bulks a falling-off Olaf.
edits.after: This is where it evens out. Olaf is front-loaded and Reckless Swing's true damage stops scaling, so bruiser items and Stormbringer's bonus Health let you survive him — but true damage ignores every point of armour you buy, so win it with sustain and the Frenzied Maul re-bite.

edits.before: Levels 3 through first item are Olaf's window. His Q Undertow slow lets him stick to you, W Vicious Strikes lifesteal wins any drawn-out trade, and E Reckless Swing deals true damage that shreds through your tankiness. At 6, Ragnarok goes unstoppable so your Q stun can't lock him during an all-in. Farm, dodge axes, and don't fight on his terms.
edits.after: Levels 3 through first item are Olaf's window. Undertow slows and shreds armour, and picking the axe back up resets its 9s cooldown, so he sticks to you; Reckless Swing is true damage that ignores your bulk; Tough It Out shields him and raises his attack speed. At 6 Ragnarok ignores your stun while he keeps swinging. Farm, deny axes, don't fight on his terms.

edits.before: With two-plus items the matchup flips decisively to you. Olaf's power is front-loaded and his true damage doesn't scale, so as the game goes long your bruiser items, sustain, and R durability leave him unable to kill you. A late Volibear out-bulks and out-DPSes a fallen-off Olaf every fight.
edits.after: With two-plus items the matchup evens out. Olaf's power is front-loaded and his true damage does not scale, so bruiser items, sustain and Stormbringer's bonus Health let you survive the all-in. But Reckless Swing still ignores armour, so beat him with the Frenzied Maul re-bite, not by stacking resistances.
